questions.q:
Which of following alcohols gives white turbidity almost immediately with the Lucas reagent at room temperature?

(i) n-Butanol

(ii) tertiary-Butanol

(iii) Benzyl alcohol

(iv) Allylic alcohol
questions.solution:
The reagent used in Lucas test are conc. HCl+ZnCl2. It gives the white turbidity or cloudiness with alcohols. It is used to distinguish between primary, secondary and tertiary alcohol. Primary alcohol give the white turbidity in 30 min. Secondary alcohol give the white turbidity in 5 min. Tertiary alcohol give the white turbidity immediately. But phenol and enol can not give Lucas test.

n-butanol is a primary alcohol and tertiary alcohol, benzyl alcohol,allylic alcohol give the turbidity immediately.
